rules.content:
title: Election-Cycle Domain Registration Spike
status: experimental
description: Detect anomalous increases in domain registrations containing financial institution brand names or financial services keywords during election periods. Compares registration volumes against a 90-day r
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: domain_registration
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        registration_volume_ratio|gte: 3.0
        baseline_window: "90d"
        domain_name|contains:
            - "financial_brand_keywords"
        registration_date_within_election|lte: "30d"
    condition: selection
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0105: Election-Cycle Domain Registration Spike (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Correlation
status: experimental
description: Detect correlations between OFAC/EU sanctions announcements and subsequent infrastructure changes. Identifies new domain registrations by sanctioned entity-linked registrars, IP block migrations, and 
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: infrastructure_correlation
    service: sanctions_feed_enriched
detection:
    selection:
        new_registrations_from_linked_registrar|exists: true
        ip_block_migration|exists: true
        new_bgp_announcement|exists: true
        event_within_sanctions_designation|lte: "14d"
    condition: selection and temporal_correlation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0106: Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Correlation (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Politically-Motivated DDoS Financial Sector Targeting
status: experimental
description: Detect Layer 7 DNS attack patterns targeting financial services infrastructure that correlate with geopolitical event timelines. Differentiates politically motivated DDoS from criminal extortion DDoS 
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: ddos_detection
    service: l7_dns_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        l7_dns_query_volume_ratio|gte: 10.0
        target_is_financial_services: true
        geopolitical_event_within|lte: "72h"
    condition: selection and timing_correlation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0107: Politically-Motivated DDoS Financial Sector Targeting (Sigma)
